D. Complete operation and future discriminating evidence

The potential microdevice opening is programmable construction AND selective replacement inside a useful3D heterogeneous module, with real connections, measured function, finite donor/head/bridge stocks and restoration. Placement, reconnecting a waveform model or choosing a new digital routing graph alone is insufficient. A current-controlling line that is electrically excellent can also be an efficient heat path; full trajectories and useful-current sensitivities matter. The easier higher-resistance case, ordinary precision assembly/rework, flex circuits and maker-claimed configurable circuits remain fair alternatives.

The potential repair opening is restoration of a useful force-displacement-work cycle and ready state from damage, including lost material, repeated delivery, interior support and renewed transport. Rapid intrinsic adhesion and actively pumped structural repair are actual but distinct predecessors. Combining their names supplies no compatible soft material, cure window, load path or autonomous mold.

A later microjoint experiment should record neighbour temperature through release AND cooldown, electrical resistance/isolation before and after, actual mechanical retention and failed-part extraction; opening a connector must not be hidden in manual preparation. A later repair experiment should include a downstream known missing-volume defect and distinguish external sealing, full material delivery, cured load transfer and subsequent feed availability. These are concrete candidate experiments for later review, not physical execution or spending authority.

No installation, API billing, new worker/model/account, purchase, outreach, hardware, source recovery, native principal query or retrieval/index/build probe occurred.
